_source: Ranges [low, high, span] per metric of tools/look_score.py: 10 inside the range, minus 10 per span outside it. indoor = measured on three interior reference frames: sat 0.43-0.59, ink (line pixels) 0.007-0.038, empty 0.06-0.26, gloss 0.066-0.112. outdoor = estimated, no outdoor frames measured. blur = share of background detail kept by the lens blur (style guide section 4: slightly soft); head = section 6. outdoor_rain = act 3 is meant to be grey (about 60 % less colour than act 1). Update with --measure when new reference frames are studied.
